title: Radar Detection Generator
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Radar_Detection_Generator.md
text: Create detection objects from radar measurements, 1 input, 1 output, {Width of actors cuboids (m)} sets Width of cuboid; {Unique identifier of sensor} sets the unique sensor identifier, {Required interval between sensor updates (s)} sets the required time interval, {Sensor’s (x,y) position (m)} sets the location of the radar sensor center, {Sensor’s height (m)} sets the radar sensor height above the ground plane, {Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)}, {Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)}, {Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)}, {Source of output bus name}, {Specify an output bus name} sets the name of output bus, {Maximum number of reported detections}, {Coordinate system used to report detections} sets the coordinate system of reported detections Ego, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Azimuthal resolution of radar (deg)} sets the azimuth resolution of radar, {Elevation resolution of radar (deg)}, {Range resolution of radar (m)}, {Range rate resolution of radar (m/s)} sets the range rate resolution of the radar, {Fractional azimuthal bias component of radar} sets the azimuth bias fraction, {Fractional elevation bias component of radar} sets the elevation bias fraction, {Fractional range bias component of radar} sets the range bias fraction, {Fractional range rate bias component of radar} sets the range rate bias fraction of the radar, {Total angular field of view for radar (deg)} sets the field of view of radar sensor, {Maximum detection range (m)}, {Minimum and maximum range rates that can be reported} sets the minimum and maximum detection range rates, {Detection probability} sets the probability of detecting a target, {Rate at which false alarms are reported} sets the false alarm rate 1e-6, {Range where detection probability is achieved (m):} sets the reference range for given probability, {Radar cross section at which detection probability is achieved (dBsm)} sets the reference radar cross-section for given probability, {Enable elevation angle measurements} enables radar to measure elevation, {Enable range rate measurements} enables radar to measure range rate, {Add noise to measurements} enables adding noise to radar sensor, {Enable false detections} enables creating false alarm radar, {Enable occlusion} enables line-of-sight occlusion, {Select method to specify initial seed} sets the method to specify random number generator seed, {Initial seed} sets the random number generator seed, {Select method to specify actor profiles} sets the method to specify actor profiles From Scenario Reader, {MATLAB expression for actor profiles}, {Unique identifier for actors} sets the scenario-defined actor identifier, {User-defined integer to classify actors} sets the user-defined classification identifier, {Length of actors cuboids (m)} sets the length of cuboid, {Height of actors cuboids (m)} sets the height of cuboid, {Rotational center of actors from bottom center (m)} sets the rotational center of the actor, {Radar cross section pattern (dBsm)} sets the radar cross-section, {Azimuth angles defining RCSPattern (deg)} sets the azimuth angles of radar cross-section pattern and {Elevation angles defining RCSPattern (deg)} sets the elevation angles of radar cross-section pattern. Values come from the instance.
